opening: I keep getting fevers that come and go.
I have painful sores (ulcers) on my legs.
The fevers and the leg sores have been going on for two months.
I have red, tender lumps on both of my legs.
After the fever with chills, I noticed my gums had become enlarged.
I've been caring for pets that were sick.
